headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts in Fierce Fighting as Central Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, combat intensity has violently surged across Weathered Expanse, where eight base exchanges occurred in the past two hours around Wightwalk and Frostmarch amidst severe casualties topping thirty-six hundred total losses. Contested action also persists in Dead Lands and Stonecradle, each logging three base transitions over the two-hour span; Dead Lands remains under intense pressure with heavy Warden attrition near The Salt March and Callahan's Boot, while Stonecradle maintains balanced, accelerating clashes near Trammel Pool. Structural movement returned to Linn of Mercy with two base flips and over two thousand combined casualties in two hours. By contrast, tactical turnover has slowed in Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts to two events apiece, with combat in Godcrofts cooling considerably while two strategic positions remain neutral no-man's-land. Callahan's Passage has quieted dramatically after earlier upheaval, recording negligible casualties and zero territorial movement over the last two hours.
